texts: [N0] UK regulatory approval of Jackdaw gas field → future North Sea capacity increase, potential supply boost

The UK approval of the Jackdaw gas field provides approximately 6% of future North Sea production capacity, representing future supply expansion; Gassco Troll capacity constraint announcements are all future plans and have not caused current supply loss. Both have limited impact on the TTF price on the day, with the overall news impact being neutral.

As of 2026‑10‑21, the TTF reference price has risen from the previous trading day by 2.44 EUR/MWh, with no immediate supply shock. The news impact is neutral, so the price is expected to continue along the upward trend.
